Definition: from the same as G3494; a youth (under forty):--young man.
BiblicalUsage: John writes to the young men because they have overcome the wicked one, and Joel promises that the young men shall see visions when the Spirit is poured out.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe young men are given strength for the fight and visions for the future: they overcome because they are strong in the word, and they see because the Spirit is poured out on them.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
